name: ac_cast
prompt: A character design sheet for a cozy island-life game: 8 different characters standing in one single row, full body, straight front view facing the camera, all drawn at the SAME pixel scale with the SAME proportions, generous empty white space between every figure, no labels. From left to right: 1) the player, a young islander with a woven straw hat, a plain teal t-shirt, brown shorts and sandals; 2) an old fisherman with a fluffy white beard, tan skin, a blue bandana, a blue and white striped shirt and a brown rubber apron; 3) a cheerful plump middle-aged farm woman with a wide straw sun hat with a pink flower, brown hair, a green dress and a floral apron; 4) a stocky boat captain with a white captain's cap, a navy peacoat, grey stubble and a small pipe; 5) a young female diving instructor with a short black bob, a dark wetsuit unzipped to the waist over a white tank top, diving goggles pushed up on her forehead; 6) a lean elderly village chief with neat grey hair, small round glasses, a light blue shirt under a khaki vest with pockets, holding a small notebook; 7) a young woman sushi chef with a long dark high ponytail and a white twisted headband, a white chef jacket and a dark indigo apron; 8) a small energetic boy about eight years old, clearly shorter than the adults, messy brown hair, a big grin, an oversized mustard yellow t-shirt with a small fish on it, carrying a little red bucket

name: ac_w_farmer
prompt: LOW RESOLUTION pixel art character sprite sheet of ONE character: the player from the second reference image (the first character: woven straw hat, plain teal t-shirt, brown shorts, sandals) in exactly that cute chibi style, drawn at EXACTLY the same pixel size and height as the character in the first reference image.
